purpose: Render a compact inline SVG trend signal.
accessibility: Requires a concise accessible label that describes the historical series.
Remains a non-interactive summary cue; use a full chart when point inspection matters.
responsive: Fills its bounded chart slot while preserving the parent card inset.
Uses non-scaling strokes so the compact line remains optically stable across widths.
motion: Reveals the complete line, fill, and endpoint through one left-to-right clip so the path never appears fragmented.
Respects prefers-reduced-motion and renders the complete series immediately.

api.name: values
api.description: Ordered finite values used to calculate the compact historical path.

api.name: label
api.description: Visible or accessible name for the control.

api.name: colorway
api.description: Selects a categorical series for soft, expressive or solid emphasis. Solid uses a centrally paired foreground; tone retains semantic meaning.

api.name: tone
api.type: chart | current | success | warning | danger | info
api.description: Selects a semantic colour or inherits currentColor on an emphasized surface.
